what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Hybrid: in person or on Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83227847126, Meeting ID 832 2784 7126); also broadcast later on local access cable, Facebook and YouTube

items.why_it_matters: The committee may close the session under Chapter 30A Section 21(a)(1) to discuss a complaint brought against a public officer, employee, staff member or individual (listed as an OML complaint, T. Loughlin); the public cannot attend that part.

items.agenda_line: a. In Person Interview Richard Mathieu, Director of Finance and Operations(3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to interview a candidate for the district's Director of Finance and Operations, a senior finance and operations post.

items.agenda_line: a. Revised Paraprofessional Salary Schedule (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A revised pay schedule for paraprofessionals is listed as an action item, which affects what the district pays those staff.

items.agenda_line: h. Vote an Amount to Fund the Special Education Reserve Fund Approved at November 2026 Town Meeting (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to vote an amount toward the Special Education Reserve Fund, which is tied to a Town Meeting approval.
The committee reviews and approves the payment warrants for this period, which are the district's bills paid.

items.agenda_line: b. Removal of Surplus Material (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to act on removing surplus district material.

items.agenda_line: c. Beginning of Year Data Presentation (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A presentation of beginning-of-year data about the schools is listed, with the Director of Teaching & Learning named as a guest.

items.agenda_line: d. COTA Position Change to .5 OT (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A change to a COTA position, to a .5 OT position, is listed as an action item and touches school staffing.

items.agenda_line: e. Brooks House Redevelopment Proposal (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A redevelopment proposal for the Brooks House is on the agenda, with the town Planning Director listed as a guest.

items.agenda_line: f. Amendment of School Calendar-Parent/Teacher Conferences (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to amend the school calendar for parent/teacher conferences, which affects families' schedules.
A report on fall athletics, a service used by students and families, is listed.

items.agenda_line: j. Discussion of Track & Field (Turf) Future Costs
items.why_it_matters: The committee is listed to discuss future costs of the track and field turf, a school facility.
